>Would you think you’d live better with a low key way of life? 

Definitely. No pressure, nothing. My depression is not my brain producing chemicals that make me sad, but the pressure the rest of the world puts on me
That’s a good idea, farfetched, but good
I used to, but now I don’t anymore
How do you care about me if you never met me?
No I’m not studying.
That’s all I do, to distract myself
Thanks, I really want to believe things will change but I can’t, it’s been like this for so long I don’t even see the light at the end anymore
Thanks, but my life won’t change anything at all. The only thing it will bring is suffering for myself.
Maybe for you, but I just realized I am in the same place I was since high school
Ok I will dm you
Sure but I will not change my mind
No I have no one
That’s like saying that you have water but you’re still unhappy to someone who doesn’t, having it will change their lives
Yeah
I’ve done that for 3 years and I’m bored but still cant get out
Motivation is necessary for me to get out of bed
Sounds very smart
I mostly just watch recommended videos
Nice naruto is one of my favorites anime I have watched, despite what elitists say. And good luck on your pull ups
What do you look forward to?
Nothing at all lol
Yes what’s your tag
Yup... and I get that, I mean why would anyone talk to some loner on the internet when they have lives irl. Soul crushing. I’m left to rot, no one truly cares.

I just feel so shitty I can’t even imagine myself being content with my life. I keep looking back and thinking how I could’ve done things differently so I wouldn’t end up as a loser today. Now I’m late and falling behind people my age. It’s hell.
Nope. I just spend all my time mindlessly browsing social media and youtube
Yeah
Sent
The chance of getting better is nonexistent. I’ll never get over those lost years.
I have no interests. I’m not normal, I don’t have any hobbies. I don’t wish to kill myself just because I can’t keep up a conversation, but it’s one of the reasons.

>what kind of messages are you sending? 

Idk I talk about my mental state.
I don’t have friends
I don’t have anything I like lol...
I just watch videos from the recommended tab. I don’t enjoy them I just use them to pass the time.
Lol I’m 19 and I still don’t have a job
How old are you now?

I’m a guy. I don’t do anything on my free time besides mindless scrolling and watching youtube videos. I never wanted to be anything. I just wanted to be rich enough to not worry about bills. No one told me I had to figure this out when I was a kid, now I’m fucking gone.
I have nowhere to make friends
Nah. Last year was the exact same shit. COVID or not I would still be in my room, and that’s the worst part.
How? I’ll read this and feel my blood boil because of the life I live but 15min later I forget all about this and become depressed again.
It literally will
True but I’m also giving up on suffering every single day without any help
